synthesizedFacts.fact: Whiteheads are a type of acne that form when pores are clogged with sebum and dead skin cells.
Whiteheads and blackheads are both comedones, but whiteheads are closed comedones while blackheads are open.
Hormonal changes, excess oil production, and dead skin cells are common causes of whiteheads.
Improper removal of whiteheads can lead to skin irritation, infection, and scarring.
Over-the-counter treatments like salicylic acid can help manage whiteheads.
